name: home-assistant-os
description: Home Assistant Operating System 18.3, generic aarch64 (UEFI) board: the buildroot-external tree on the home-assistant fork of Buildroot 2024.02, internal glibc toolchain, systemd, Docker, a 6.18 mainline kernel
notes: Deviations from the board's own defconfig, applied to golden and Buck2 alike: no ccache (its cache directory is outside the build), no post-image script (it assembles disk images outside the rootfs), and a tar rootfs instead of EROFS so the manifest scanner can read it. hassio is excluded too: it downloads seven Docker container images at build time from a moving version file (version.home-assistant.io) and builds a data partition with Docker-in-Docker, all for the disk images (`HASSIO_INSTALL_IMAGES`); it installs nothing into the root filesystem, and its inputs change over time, so it can be neither hermetic nor compared byte for byte. native: three packages (the native skeleton recipe requires skeleton-init-sysv; this is systemd).
